FAQ

Frequently
asked questions.

Everything a contracting business runs on: Lisa answering your phone 24/7, missed-call text-back, a calendar with a public booking page, contacts and messaging, estimates, contracts with e-signature, projects with photos and costs, invoices, finances with profit per job, an instant-quote calculator for your site, the marketing tools, and your exclusive Lead Radar territory.

No. BuilderPro OS runs roofing, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, painting, concrete, remodeling, pools and landscaping companies. Lisa is trained on your trade, the calculator is built around your services, and the model sites cover every one of them.

Most clients are live in 3 to 4 days. We train Lisa on your business, import your customers and open jobs, connect your phone line and calendar, and hand you a working system. You just start answering fewer calls.

Only if you want one. A website is an add-on at $49 a month on any plan. We build it on one of the four model sites, tailor it to your brand, photos and services, and host and maintain it. If you already have a site you like, keep it and embed the calculator and booking page on it.

Lisa is your 24/7 AI receptionist. She answers calls and texts, explains your services, gives ballpark pricing you approve, qualifies the customer and books the appointment straight into your calendar. When you miss a call, she texts the caller back within seconds. She is trained on your business, your hours and your service area.

No long-term contracts. Cancel anytime. We earn your business every month by keeping your jobs, your money and your customers in order, not by locking you in.

You pay the one-time setup fee, we get everything built and live within 3 to 4 days, and then your 14-day trial begins on the full, live system with real calls and real jobs. At the end of 14 days you keep going or you walk away.

It covers the real hard costs of switching you on: your business phone number, the carrier registration required to send texts, training Lisa on your business, and importing your customers and open jobs. It is a one-time charge.

No. We set everything up and keep it running. You get one dashboard where you see your calls, jobs, invoices and profit, and the Lisa tab where you can change what she says. Nothing technical to touch.

A calculator you embed on your website that lets a customer price a job in under a minute, whether that is a roof measured from satellite imagery, an HVAC tune-up or a pool build. Before showing the number it captures their name, phone and email, and the lead lands in your portal with Lisa following up.
